NumericalHistoryPolicy.description:
Explicit operator-selected thresholds, not universal convergence criteria.
The enclosing inspection request retains this policy beside its statements.

barrier_progress_minimum.description: Minimum relative decrease in barrier accompanying a primal-stall question.

inertia_fraction_minimum.description: Selected inertia-correction fraction, under one complete factor population.

minimum_events.description: Required consecutive source events, at least two.

primal_progress_maximum.description: Maximum relative reduction in the same native primal measure.

raw_recycle_ratio_minimum.description:
Selected consecutive absolute residual ratio for each captured raw-map
coordinate. Native input points may be accelerated; this is no contraction norm.

repeated_worst_row.description: Ask whether the same owner-supplied original worst row recurs.

tiny_step_maximum.description: Tiny native-step question, in the source's declared norm/coordinates.

version.description: Interpretation version; only version 1 is supported.

OperationIdBody.description: Process instance plus local sequence; never a semantic or cache identity.

process_instance.description: Process-local instance locator; not a semantic identity or attestation.

description: Request for copied diagnostics only; it cannot request scientific work or result admission.

include_related.description: Copy bounded directly related operations; deeper navigation selects their exact IDs.

numerical_history_policy.description: Explicit selected analytical thresholds; absent means only common factual interpretations.

operation.description: Exact operation selected by its diagnostic process instance and sequence.

related_limit.description: Maximum directly related snapshots; effective ceiling is 32.

window.description: Requested recent interval, clamped to observed operation lifetime.

title: InspectionRequest
